Profile.title: Profile
Profile.offer:
We offer a unique bonus program that allows you to save more with every order:
1. Bronze (10%): earned from the 1st to the 4th order.
2. Silver (20%): earned from the 5th to the 9th order.
3. Gold (30%): earned starting from the 10th order.
Profile.how_it_work:
How does it work?
• After each order, you earn bonuses depending on your level: Bronze, Silver, or Gold.
• You can use up to 100% of the accumulated bonuses to pay for any dish from our menu.

AboutUsPage.title: About Us
AboutUsPage.introBottom: Rolling Sushi is a place where every detail is thoughtfully designed with care and attention for you. We believe that food should bring joy and create special moments that stay in your memory for a long time.
AboutUsPage.description: The perfect combination of taste and quality. We use only fresh ingredients and prepare with love to make every order a true delight for you. *** Accessibility for everyone. We strive to bring Japanese cuisine closer and more understandable to the residents of Tashkent. *** Care in every detail. We think not only about taste but also about making your experience simple and comfortable.
AboutUsPage.descriptionBottom: Rolling Sushi is about cozy family dinners, heartfelt gatherings with friends, or moments to treat yourself to something special. We want every visit or order to leave you with only pleasant memories.
AboutUsPage.logoBottom: Thank you for trusting us to make your day a little better!

Register.title: Register and enjoy Rolling Sushi even more!
